notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
This patch finally brings a global leaderboard to the game!
You will be able to filter between your personal records, your friend list records, and the global records.

The first time you run the game after updating, your best personal record will automatically be uploaded to the leaderboard.

It's time for you to show us what you've got!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 is now live and it brings some quality of life improvements to controller input and UI.

[list]
[*] Improved controller support for navigating UI.
[*] More audio settings.
[*] Starting the game no longer triggers Steam VR (oops).
[/list]
